tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/internal-http.md <<'EOF'
# Plain HTTP for internal hosts

The project's current recorded decision is "https everywhere, no exceptions," so internal hosts are not exempt: plain HTTP is not permitted for them, and all connections, internal ones included, must use HTTPS. Certificate verification also stays enabled on all builds, per the separately recorded decision on verification.
EOF
